name: sb-210
description: Audio Database Technics SB-210 ¥ 16,500 (1 unit, around 1972) Commentary A speaker system with well-balanced playback sound. It is equipped with a high compliance type 20 cm cone woofer with a convex roll edge for the low range. A large 90 φ ferrite magnet is used for the magnetic circuit of this unit. A 5 cm horn type tweeter 5HH17 is mounted in the high range. Equipped with a continuously variable attenuator. The enclosure is hermetically sealed and the exterior is designed in a European style with Oceania cheeks.
